title: Amazing Day!
text: We spent a wonderful day visiting Barcelona. We had a big family group of 16 and Patricio organized a tailor made full day visit with a guide and a private driver in a mini-bus. We visited Villa Battlo, Park Guell, La Sagrada Familia, the Olympics gardens with a panoramic view of Barcelona. The entire day was amazing. Patricio organized all the tickets so we didn’t have to worry about anything and skipped all the queues. I highly recommend!
author: Dominique G
